purpose: Development-only retraining of genuine four-specialist and five-specialist organ banks under two frozen budget views, with matched connected-study-preserving random controls and target-hidden cross-fit routing.

authorization.scope: one calibration-only K4-versus-K5 retraining comparison; no test access and no external confirmation authorization

evidence_label.reason: K4 was selected with the same calibration cohort and the existing study-disjoint test was already inspected

prior_evidence.guardrail: the subset is frozen before retraining; no subset or organ may be reselected in this run

data.primary_weighting: equal organ mass, then equal connected-study mass within organ

score_firewall.router_rule: reuse the frozen connected-study cross-fit five-class organ router; all 4634 score genes were replaced by the mask token before every fit and prediction
score_firewall.k4_rule: collapse predicted adipose to pooled fallback; never refit or select a K-specific router

partitions.k4_random_population: the same four active-organ rows used by organ K4; adipose is pooled fallback
partitions.k4_random_assignment: within train and calibration separately, assign each entire connected study to one of four shards by deterministic outcome-free bin packing balancing total and per-organ sample counts
partitions.k5_random_assignment: reuse the three previously frozen connected-study-preserving K5 axes exactly
partitions.gate_rule: every organ candidate must pass against all three matched random partitions; no favorable partition selection

training.architecture: frozen pooled trunk plus independent dimension-64 residual adapters
training.dispatch_loss: assigned-expert masked reconstruction MSE; fallback rows contribute exactly zero adapter loss divided by the common batch size
training.sampling: one deterministic natural full-five-organ schedule shared by all banks within a seed
training.shared_semantic_initialization: the four common organ experts use identical initialization keys across K5 and K4; K4 budget arms share initialization keys
training.checkpoint_policy: predetermined final update only; no calibration checkpoint selection

k4_equal_per_expert.interpretation: paired ablation and efficiency view; independent shared experts should match their K5 counterparts

k4_equal_active_exposure_total.interpretation: compute-reallocation sensitivity; equalizes active adapter exposures, not literal end-to-end wall-clock FLOPs

evaluation.primary_estimand: connected-study cross-fit blind hard routing versus pooled on equal-organ/equal-study MSE
evaluation.specialization_estimand: true-organ with pooled fallback versus each assigned connected-study-preserving random control
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm correction across the three arm-versus-pooled tests and separately across the nine arm-by-random-partition tests
evaluation.noninferiority_family: two one-sided K4-versus-K5 comparisons controlled at family alpha 0.05 using 97.5th-percentile paired clustered-bootstrap upper bounds

selection_rule.k4_robust: both K4 arms pass specialization gates and both are noninferior to K5; nominate the equal-per-expert K4 artifact as the lower-active-exposure candidate
selection_rule.k4_budget_dependent: the equal-active-total K4 arm passes specialization gates and is noninferior, while equal-per-expert K4 is not
selection_rule.k4_efficient: the equal-per-expert K4 arm passes specialization gates and is noninferior while equal-active-total K4 is not
selection_rule.k5_retained: K5 passes specialization gates and equal-active-total K4 fails its gates or its noninferiority bound
selection_rule.no_supported_split: none of K5, equal-per-expert K4, or equal-active-total K4 passes the unchanged specialization gates
selection_rule.inconclusive: all other patterns; default to no architecture change
